pairs.registryProposal: When a repository standard defines projection from a canonical agent guidance file (e.g. AGENTS.md) into vendor-specific instruction files, host-contract-compilation should extend beyond skill compilation to prescribe declarative transformation contracts for instruction documents (specifying host-specific frontmatter, section suppression, and tool vocabulary maps) rather than relying on inlined generator heuristics.
